title: FST
summary: A small collection of Jupyter notebooks that experiment with generating synthetic tabular data and evaluating its quality against real data. The notebooks import and run SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer, define metadata with SingleTableMetadata, and call evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic to assess the synthetic output.
evidence: synthesis2.ipynb:99-116 instantiates and fits GaussianCopulaSynthesizer; synthesis.ipynb:403 instantiates CTGANSynthesizer with metadata
needs: No README present; repository domain/purpose beyond notebook code is unclear, and no authors are named anywhere in the evidence.
